assumptions: Power is Genus Joules at default 50% switching activity without VCD; per-event energy = (internal+switching) power / 1000 MHz, per dynamic-event cycle.
Synthesis-only: no place-and-route wire parasitics (Innovus OOM on the vlsi host).
All 24 basics measured at their exact widths; additive structural composition remains an estimate, not whole-module characterization.
Per-event energies use the 1 GHz source clock; the pipeline time base remains 500 MHz.
caveat: ASAP7 Genus synthesis-only at 1 GHz (CLK_PERIOD_NS=1.0), mixed shipped libraries (AO/INVBUF/OA/SEQ 0.77V/0C, SIMPLE 0.70V/25C), Joules power at the default 50% switching activity without VCD, no place-and-route parasitics; prices applied to the 7nm/500MHz performance model
